import json, random, subprocess, sys, time
import genhard, genfeas, genmax, genmaxp, check
import numpy as np

def make(rng, i):
    k = i % 5
    if k == 0: return genhard.gen_request(rng)
    if k == 1: return genfeas.gen_request(rng)
    if k == 2: return genmax.gen_request(rng, "easy")
    if k == 3: return genmaxp.gen_request(rng)
    return genhard.gen_request(rng)

seed = int(sys.argv[1]); batches = int(sys.argv[2])
rng = random.Random(seed)
total_bad = 0; total = 0
t_all = time.time()
for b in range(batches):
    reqs = [make(rng, b*64+i) for i in range(64)]
    data = ("\n".join(json.dumps(r) for r in reqs)+"\n").encode()
    t0 = time.time()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,"/app/submission/planner.py"], input=data,
                       capture_output=True, timeout=600)
    dt = time.time()-t0
    lines = p.stdout.decode().splitlines()
    if p.returncode != 0:
        print("RC FAIL", p.returncode, p.stderr.decode()[-800:]); total_bad += 1; continue
    if len(lines) != len(reqs):
        print("LINE COUNT", len(lines), len(reqs)); total_bad += 1; continue
    for req, line in zip(reqs, lines):
        resp = json.loads(line)
        errs = check.check(req, resp)
        total += 1
        if errs:
            total_bad += 1
            print("FAIL:", errs)
            print(" req:", json.dumps(req)[:300])
            print(" resp:", line[:300])
            if total_bad > 5: break
    print("batch %d: %.2fs" % (b, dt), flush=True)
print("total=%d bad=%d elapsed=%.1fs" % (total, total_bad, time.time()-t_all))
PYEOF
